thread:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PAGED: Unusual egress from staging-logshipper -> external s3 (high confidence)

maria (oncall): seeing it, joining. where's the runbook?

olivia (inc-commander): I'm on call too. initial ask: pause log forwarding, isolate svcacct, assess customer exposure.

kevin (sec): confirmed odd pattern: repeated multipart uploads to an external s3 host we don't recognize. Samples show header with `x-service-account: svc-logshipper-staging`. Low-volume but persistent.

maria (oncall): running quick checks now. grep across last 24h: `grep -R "svc-logshipper-staging" /var/logs/shipper/* | wc -l`

ops-bot: command queued: `kubectl -n staging scale deployment/logshipper 0` (waiting approval)

maria (oncall): approved, scaling to 0 now.

ops-bot: deployment/logshipper scaled to 0

kevin (sec): good stop. Next: revoke the staging forwarder key, create ephemeral creds and block external host at perimeter.

olivia (inc-commander): kevin, can you paste the quick key rotate steps? we need to handoff to infra.

kevin (sec): steps (short):
1) disable svcacct by setting `allowed_token=false` in IAM config for `svc-logshipper-staging`.
2) issue new key pair in KMS: `kms create-key --purpose rotate-logshipper`
3) revoke old key: `kms revoke-key --id <old>`
4) patch deployments that embed creds (none running now)
5) request S3 provider block on external bucket 

Do these in that order.

maria (oncall): running step 1: `iamctl set svc-logshipper-staging --allowed=false` --> success.

ops-bot: IAM update propagated to all regions

kevin (sec): creating rotation key now. generating limited-scope ephemeral creds for diagnostics only.

jess (cust-success): heads-up: do we have customer-facing impact? any customer data sent?

kevin (sec): preliminary sample shows a handful of staging logs (non-prod) uploaded. No production tenant IDs found in the sampled payloads, but we need to audit full window 00:00-08:00 UTC.

olivia (inc-commander): jess, prep a holding message template (no mention of breach). Proposed text: "We've detected and contained an automated staging log forwarder misconfiguration. We're rotating service credentials and auditing to confirm no customer data was affected. We'll update in 4 hours." ok?

jess (cust-success): that works. I'll queue it to the status page draft.

tariq (legal): hold on external comms until we confirm audit outcomes. Keep draft internal. Legal to review if any PII is suspected.

kevin (sec): full audit kickoff: running `s3grep --pattern "tenant_id|user_id|email" --range 00:00-08:00 --source staging-forwarder-uploads` and `sha256sum` fingerprinting on uploaded objects. ETA ~45m.

maria (oncall): ops has blocked outbound host at edge: `fwctl block ip 198.51.100.23`

ops-bot: edge firewall rule deployed: blocked 198.51.100.23

kevin (sec): old key revoked: `kms revoke-key --id key-0abc123` -> success. New ephemeral creds created for sec only.

maria (oncall): confirm: no running forwarders in staging, IAM disallowed, edge blocked, key revoked. Anything else?

kevin (sec): start log re-ingest hold: ensure we don't reprocess those external objects into any analytics queues. Patch pipeline: `patch pipeline/log-indexer --env SKIP_EXTERNAL_REINGEST=true`

ops-bot: pipeline/log-indexer patched, skip flag set

olivia (inc-commander): designate next actions: 1) finish audit (kevin), 2) runlist of uploaded objects and quick grep for PII (maria/kevin), 3) legal review (tariq), 4) if clear, post holding notice and then a follow-up with details. Triage window 4h.

jess (cust-success): prepping internal comms to CS leads so they can field questions if status page goes live.

kevin (sec): audit progress: ~12% scanned, no PII matches yet. Posting incremental findings to secure doc.

maria (oncall): capturing timeline for postmortem: observed spikes at 01:12 UTC, automated forwarder retried 1,237 times to external host, first upload 01:15 UTC.

olivia (inc-commander): bookmarking for postmortem. Also creating an action item: restrict staging forwarder svcacct permissions to explicitly deny external-bucket writes by default.

kevin (sec): agreed. We'll add deny rule in IAM policy: `deny: s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::* unless arn:aws:s3:::redwood-internal-*`

tariq (legal): once audit completes, I need a list of object keys and their hashes. If anything with PII is found we escalate to privacy team.

maria (oncall): quick note: discovered a stale config in `deployments/logshipper/config.yaml` that referenced `external_s3_endpoint: https://uploads-legacy.example.net`. It should have been removed in last cleanup.

kevin (sec): that explains the leak path. Add config cleanup to remediation.

olivia (inc-commander): great catch. action items assigned:
- maria: verify no other deploys reference legacy endpoint (check infra repo).
- ops: rotate any remaining keys tied to svc-logshipper-staging across secrets manager.
- kevin: finish audit and deliver object list.

- jess: prepare external comms draft pending legal ok.
